encoder: a Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) builder for the keel and part P1; a Sonnet 5.5 lead ran the closing pass (verification on both builds, an independent test author on Sonnet, an adversarial refuter on Opus)
display_name: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (the GDPR), part P1 and the keel: Articles 2(1)-(2), 4(1), (2), (6)-(8), 5 to 11 and 24; two seats
seat: Two seats: a data subject and a controller (seats for a processor, a data protection officer, a representative and a certification body come with later parts); each asks, on facts it can state, what the Regulation asks of it (assumed, not ruled). There is no seat for an authority.
edition: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, the Publications Office consolidated version of 4.5.2016 (CELEX 02016R0679-20160504), which applies the corrigendum of OJ L 127, 23.5.2018, rendered to plain text by a script; the recitals are reading aids from the as-published text; not the Official Journal text.
not_reviewed: No lawyer or other domain expert has read this encoding against the text, and it has not been checked against the Official Journal. The readings flagged for a lawyer (NOTES.md) are not rulings.

scope.encoded: Articles 2(1)-(2), 4 points (1), (2), (6), (7), (8), 5 to 11 and 24; the coverage table is in NOTES.md
scope.inputs_not_encoded: judgements the text leaves to a person or an authority, and the defined terms of Article 4 outside this part, taken as inputs
